title: TrajToM Sketch Schema
description: Structured psychological sketch for the TrajToM benchmark. Generated from profile before dialogue; serves as ground-truth annotation for ToM questions.

information_asymmetry.description: Private knowledge each character holds. All fields are null when information_asymmetry_type is no_asymmetry (except shared_false_assumption, which may still apply).

A_knows_but_B_doesnt.description: Concrete fact A privately holds that B does not know.

B_knows_but_A_doesnt.description: Concrete fact B privately holds that A does not know.

shared_false_assumption.description: A false belief both characters share. May be non-null even when no_asymmetry.

causal_chain.description: Three causal statements explaining why states are what they are.

chain_1.description: How A's belief or information state causes A's emotion or behavior.

chain_2.description: How B's desire or information gap drives B's behavior toward A.

chain_3.description: How the information asymmetry (or value difference if no_asymmetry) produces a specific misread between A and B.

second_order_states.description: What each character thinks about the other's mental state. B_about_A: at least 2 of 3 fields non-null. A_about_B: at least 1 of 2 fields non-null. All misreads must differ from the actual state.

B_about_A.description: B's (possibly wrong) beliefs about A's inner states.

emotion.description: Format: 'B thinks A feels [X] (actual: [Y]) | triggered by: [Z].' Z = observable behavior/statement that causes the misread.

belief.description: Core false-belief field for Type 1 belief_reasoning (order=2). Format: 'B thinks A believes [X] (actual: [Y]) | triggered by: [Z].'

intention.description: Format: 'B thinks A intends [X] (actual: [Y]) | triggered by: [Z].'

A_about_B.description: A's (possibly wrong) beliefs about B's inner states.

belief.description: Format: 'A thinks B believes [X] (actual: [Y]) | triggered by: [Z].'

intention.description: Format: 'A thinks B intends [X] (actual: [Y]) | triggered by: [Z].'

belief.description: Template: '[Name] believes [proposition].' May be false or partial.

intention.description: Template: '[Name] intends to [action] in order to [goal].'

desire.description: Template: '[Name] ultimately wants [deep outcome].' Stable across phases by default.

standard_phase.description: Psychological states of both characters at one conversation phase.

character_shifts.description: State shifts for one character at the key moment. emotion/belief/intention are required. desire is optional 鈥?fill only if deep motivation genuinely shifts.

key_moment_phase.description: The turning-point event and the state shifts it causes.

trigger.description: The specific statement, event, or realization that causes the shift.

key_moment_type.description: Structural type of the turning point.
